verdicts.reason: A keeps the city and headphones, but the reading order is broken: the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow sits below the body copy, and the logo sits bottom-left on the busy lit skyline. The headline is jammed against the top edge, there is a dead gap above the CTA, and the right ear cup touches the card edge. B has a clean hierarchy with logo and eyebrow on top, then headline and body, but it drops the city skyline entirely and shrinks the headphones to a trivial icon. Its small centred CTA is crammed against the bottom edge and does not line up with the left-aligned text.
